summary: Iteration 4 validated end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 new pytest cases in test_iter4.py pass (variables {var}+{{var}}; scheduler picks jobs and increments attempts on transient SMTP errors; recipient stats include open_count/click_count/attempts; /api/track/open/{tid}.png without auth returns image/png, sets status=opened, sets opened_at, increments open_count, preserves opened_at on subsequent hits; /api/track/click/{tid}?url=… returns 307 to target URL, sets status=clicked, clicked_at and click_count; signature_html persists on smtp; /smtp/test-send works with signature override). Regression: existing backend_test.py 46/46 pass (serial). Frontend: Templates → Novo template: all RTE toolbar testids present (rte-bold/italic/underline/font/size/color/highlight/ul/ol/left/center/right/justify/link/image/variable), tabs (rte-tab-visual/code/preview) switch correctly, rte-editor content propagates to rte-html-input and rte-preview, rte-variable dropdown inserts {first_name} into HTML, save-template-button persists content_html, delete + confirm works.

issues: A11y warning: DialogContent/AlertDialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby — non-blocking, cosmetic.

action_items: Optional: add aria-describedby (or a <DialogDescription>) to Template dialog and confirm-delete AlertDialog to remove Radix a11y warnings.
Optional: expose tracking_id on GET /api/campaigns/{id}/stats recipients so external clients (and easier testing) can trigger open/click endpoints without direct DB access.

Optional: campaign settings only accept nested `settings` object; top-level min_interval_seconds/business_hour_* on POST /api/campaigns are silently dropped by Pydantic. Consider explicit 422 or a compat shim.
critical_code_review_comments: worker._send_job: signature is appended to html_body AND converted to text via html_to_text — good; also falls back to legacy plain-text `signature` field.
email_service.inject_open_pixel: uses 1x1 img without display:none — correct for tracking (many clients strip hidden images).
api.track_open: only promotes status when currently in OPEN_TRACKED_STATUSES (sent/delivered/sending/pending) — will NOT downgrade replied/bounced/failed. Good.
api.track_click: same protection + also sets opened_at if missing — good.

worker._send_job retry: transient errors reset status to 'pending', increment attempts, backoff = 60*attempts seconds, up to max_attempts=3, then 'failed'. Permanent bounces (regex on 550/551/553/5.1.x/mailbox…) go to 'bounced' immediately and mark contact.status='bounce'. Correct.
core: /api/track/* correctly registered without auth dependency.
seed_data_creation: test_iter4.py creates TEST_iter4_smtp/grp/template/contact/campaign and cleans up on teardown. UI test created and deleted TEST_ui_iter4_tpl.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter4.py must be run serially (`-n 0`) OR isolated per-worker because its module-scoped `seed` fixture inserts a contact with a fixed email. backend_test.py also has the same cross-class dependency and must be run with `-n 0` (the default -n 2 loadscope splits by CLASS and breaks TestGroups._created['id'] sharing). Consider consolidating in future. /api/track/* are unauth. Real SMTP is unreachable in the preview env, so job transitions to 'sent' are simulated in tests by directly writing status='sent' via pymongo before hitting the tracking endpoint.
